$schema_note: v2 reference for the basal-phenotype report card. Axes carry presentation + a TYPED criterion. Population-stat axes grade by Welch t-test of candidate per-cell values vs these blessed reference values (cell-level n). A SIGNIFICANT difference (p<p_min) is drift/mismatch. Self-pin => p=1.0 at baseline; future drift / PDMP lowers p. Judgement is deferred: the pin is current main's behavior, not a biological target.

stimulus.ensemble: 4 seeds x 8 gens, generation_lower_bound=3 -> 20 cells (17 divided); 29/32 generations divided
stimulus.cache_provenance: FULL-mode ParCa cache (out/cache_full). Shipped fixture is fast-mode and won't reproduce it; requires a full ParCa run. cache_version inputs_hash does not distinguish fast/full.

growth.doubling_time.label: Doubling time
growth.doubling_time.how: Mean division time over confirmed divisions. One value per cell (gens≥3); population stats across the 17 cells. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis.py::BasalPhenotypeCard.

composition.protein_fraction.label: Protein / dry weight
composition.protein_fraction.how: Time-mean protein mass fraction of dry weight. One value per cell (gens≥3); population stats across the 20 cells. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis.py::BasalPhenotypeCard.

composition.rna_fraction.label: Total RNA / dry weight
composition.rna_fraction.how: Time-mean total-RNA (rRna+tRna+mRna) mass fraction of dry weight. One value per cell (gens≥3); population stats across the 20 cells. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis.py::BasalPhenotypeCard.

composition.dna_fraction.label: DNA / dry weight
composition.dna_fraction.how: Time-mean DNA mass fraction of dry weight. One value per cell (gens≥3); population stats across the 20 cells. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis.py::BasalPhenotypeCard.

findings: Population-stat axes grade by Welch t-test on cell-level values (n=cells, not timepoints). Self-pin => p=1.0; this establishes the baseline. Caveat: a t-test flags DIFFERENCE; 'not significantly different' is not a formal equivalence proof (TOST would be), but it is a sound drift gate for a regression pin.

3 of 32 generations did not divide (ran to the 3600 s cap); their over-grown cells are still in the composition average (n=20). A refinement would restrict composition to divided cells; effect is small (fractions are per-dry-weight).
open_questions: Omics + behavioral axes land in Layer 3-4 (transcriptome/proteome R²; Bucket A boolean assertions).
